title: Debug logging doesn't work properly
body:
While investigating https://github.com/kubernetes/registry.k8s.io/issues/333, skopeo's debug flag wasn't so helpful as gcrane's verbose flag.

Can we make the following changes:
- print the request headers
- print the response headers
- print the body of all responses except blobs
- if there is an error message, we don't cap it at 50 characters.

Good example: `gcrane pull registry.k8s.io/bom/bom:v0.5.0 /tmp/image.tar --verbose`

comments.body: Thanks for your report. This is, for the most part, already tracked for Skopeo as #1392.
Thank you, let's expedite that feature as it would have saved a lot of debugging time
